Callout.Name: Gang Intimidation
Callout.Message: Group intimidating a shop owner on his doorstep.
Callout.Advisory: Three males, no weapons seen, shop owner frightened.

Script.Line: Nobody is intimidating anybody. We are delivering a message.
He owes money to people and that is his problem.
You can stand there all day. It does not change anything.

Lines.Approach: Three of them at his door and he is on his own inside. Nobody has been hit yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
